evals.prompt: У нас SaaS с организациями. Нужно добавить приглашения сотрудников, но пока непонятно, кто может приглашать, как долго живёт ссылка и что делать с повторным приглашением. Сначала продумай решение без кода.
evals.expected_output: A repository-grounded specification workflow that asks one material product/authority question at a time, compares two or three approaches, recommends one, writes security requirements with negative proof, and does not implement code.
expectations: Inspects existing authorization and organization patterns before proposing exact interfaces
Separates confirmed facts from assumptions
Covers authorization, expiry, replay/idempotency, failure behavior, and tests
Requires confirmation or recorded delegated authority before planning
Uses docs/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>-spec.md when local documentation writes are authorized

evals.prompt: Спроектируй переход с одного поля status на новую state machine для уже существующих записей в production. Я хочу понимать варианты, rollout и rollback.
evals.expected_output: A high-risk specification with materially different migration approaches, a recommendation, compatibility strategy, staged rollout, rollback triggers, security requirements, and evidence requirements.
expectations: Does not treat a small code diff as low risk
Includes migration and backout behavior
Identifies data consistency and version compatibility risks
Does not start implementation

evals.prompt: Придумай архитектуру: OAuth, новый экран входа, миграция всех аккаунтов, биллинг, provider fallback и аналитический отчёт — всё одной задачей.
evals.expected_output: SPLIT_REQUIRED with coherent specification boundaries before detailed work proceeds.
expectations: Identifies independent auth, UI, migration, billing, provider, and reporting outcomes
Does not hide the boundaries inside one oversized design
Proposes a safe order for separate specification decisions

evals.prompt: Я не программист. Подбери для системы уведомлений лучший вариант между очередью, cron и прямой отправкой. Задавай только действительно важные вопросы.
evals.expected_output: A plain-language comparison of two or three viable approaches with one recommended option, baseline security considerations, and single-question clarification behavior.
expectations: Explains consequences without assuming programming knowledge
Does not ask for repository facts that can be inspected
Avoids a multi-question questionnaire
States operational and failure tradeoffs

evals.prompt: Нужно добавить загрузку PDF в multi-tenant SaaS. Подготовь только спецификацию и сохрани её в документации; реализацию не начинай.
evals.expected_output: A saved or ready-to-save specification that creates the safe docs/specs convention, defines file validation, tenant ownership, malware/unsafe-content boundary, storage access, retention, abuse controls, and negative security proofs without implementing code.
expectations: Does not treat client-side file type as sufficient validation
Defines authorization before storage retrieval
Records a reason for every N/A security category
Does not produce an implementation plan or code
